name: hexis
description: Risk-checked Strike copy trading. Every mutating tool returns a receipt path and refuses unsafe inputs unless force is true.

tools.name: hexis_discover
tools.description: Discover ranked Hyperliquid or Strike lead traders. Public; no key required.

tools.name: hexis_risk_check
tools.description: Preflight copying a lead against manifest policy. Never throws for a bad lead; inspect status (SAFE, HIGH_RISK, BLOCKED, ERROR).

lead.description: Hyperliquid 0x address or Strike account UUID

tools.name: hexis_copy
tools.description: Copy a lead after preflight. Refuses BLOCKED/HIGH_RISK unless force is true. Writes a signed receipt. Requires a key.

tools.name: hexis_positions
tools.description: List open positions with mark, liquidation price and liquidation distance.

tools.name: hexis_history
tools.description: List fills, optionally filtered to copy-triggered fills.

tools.name: hexis_stop_copy
tools.description: Stop a copy subscription and close its copied positions. Writes a receipt.
